command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: Wrong requirement tags in the new unit BDD features and their steps comments. `.claude/rules/antipatterns.md` says: "Vague traceability — ... If the reference is not explicit, it does not exist." The day-colouring spec says the working-time requirements implement "FR8, FR10" (day tracks) and "FR8, FR11" (hour cells). But `packages/client/src/test/features/day_colouring/day_colouring_day_tracks.feature` tags "Working-time stops on a Monday" `@FR13` (FR13 in proposal.md is the hour frame colour), "Friday still works where Saturday has not begun" `@FR15` (FR15 is "Every string ... SHALL exist in every locale file") and "Working time after a clock change" `@FR16`, which does not exist (the proposal stops at FR15). `day_colouring_hour_cells.feature` tags "Half of the hour decides" `@FR14` (FR14 is the option group / time range group), "Weekend cells and Friday cells across the reference day" `@FR15` and "Hour cells on a clock change day" `@FR16`. The `// @add-day-colouring-setting ...` comments in `steps/day_colouring_day_tracks.steps.ts:149,168` and `steps/day_colouring_hour_cells.steps.ts:111,139` repeat the wrong IDs. Use FR8/FR10 for the track scenarios and FR8/FR11 for the cell scenarios.

Touched production files lack the change's traceability line. The rule in tasks.md says: "Every new or touched production file gets a JSDoc line `Implements <ids> of add-day-colouring-setting (D<n>).`" `packages/client/src/presenter/hourStrip.ts` now replaces `dayPeriod` with `dayColour`, adds `dayColouring`/`workingHours` to `HourStripContext` and its cache key, and calls `getHourCellWorkingFlags`/`presentHourCellColour`, but its JSDoc names only add-grid-hour-cells-and-hour-frame. `packages/client/src/controller/useLocations.ts` now reads `useDayColouring()` and passes `dayColouring`/`workingHours` into the rows context and the memo deps, with no add-day-colouring-setting line. `packages/client/src/views/grid/GridView.tsx` now passes `colour={hourFrameColour}` to `HourFrame` (task 6.3), with no add-day-colouring-setting line. Add e.g. `Implements FR11, FR12, NFR-P1 of add-day-colouring-setting (D4).` to hourStrip.ts, `FR3, FR12 ... (D4)` to useLocations.ts and `FR13 ... (D7)` to GridView.tsx.

findings.message: Task 9.3 is ticked but not done as written. tasks.md says: 'Its steps go in `steps/day_colouring_view_contract_e2e.steps.ts`. They read the day track's background gradient in Cards and the cells' computed background in Grid, through a per-view helper in the existing view contract fixtures (`src/test/features/view_contract/steps/`).' No `day_colouring_view_contract_e2e.steps.ts` exists. The steps for `day_colouring_view_contract_e2e.feature` ('every day colour of the "..." row is the accent colour', 'the "..." row shows the accent colour at 12:00 and the non-working grey at 20:00 of Almaty') are in `day_colouring/steps/day_colouring_e2e.steps.ts:129-161` and use the `locationsWorld` fixture from `locations_ui_e2e.fixtures`. The colour reading is `readRowDayColours` in `day_colouring/steps/dayColouringE2eHelpers.ts`, which finds the view by checking for `[data-hour-cell]` in the DOM. `view_contract/steps/view_contract_e2e.fixtures.ts` has no per-view colour helper. This also breaks `.claude/rules/bdd-unit.md` ('one steps file per feature file'). Fix: create `day_colouring_view_contract_e2e.steps.ts` for that feature and add the per-view Cards/Grid colour reader to the view contract fixtures.

Task 5.3 says: 'Add cases to `src/controller/useLocations.dayTrack.test.tsx` and `src/controller/useHourGrid.test.tsx`: a colouring change re-presents the rows, and a minute tick in Working hours returns the same stops and strip.' Those cases are in a new file, `src/controller/useDayColouring.presenting.test.tsx`, not in the two files the task names. Either move them, or update tasks.md so it matches what was done.
